_about.note: Evidence category of every ScienceBalance field and of the numbers in data/samples.json and data/salvage.json (Prompt 08, Part S). Categories: balance (game tuning, no source; never a NASA figure), illustrative (a made-up value shown in place of a measurement), S06 (PDS Geosciences Node page for MSL CheMin, PARTIAL in docs/source_register.md: supports only the mission, instrument, Gale crater site and data set name of the lab reference, and that CheMin measures mineral abundance by X-ray diffraction; it holds no mineral values). No other register entry is used.

samples_per_site.note: 3 samples per site, so one site cannot fill every pack.

clear_sky_tau.note: 0.6: below it the sample label says 'clear sky'. Words only; dust opacity has no checked source (register section 10).

dusty_sky_tau.note: 1.0: above it the sample label says 'dusty sky'.

mineral_uncertainty_pct.note: +/- 6 percentage points on each mineral share the lab shows. Not a CheMin figure.

calibrated_mineral_uncertainty_pct.note: +/- 2 percentage points after sci_instrument_calibration. Not a CheMin figure.

result_uncertainty.note: +/- 0.08 on the nutrient setting (0..1) of a lab result.

nutrient_setting_volcanic.note: 0.6. Made up for the game: the planter mix contains crushed local ground; growing crops in Mars ground has not been shown (register section 4 note, section 10).

nutrient_setting_clay.note: 0.45. Made up for the game (as above).

nutrient_setting_sulfate.note: 0.3. Made up for the game (as above).

refurbish_hours.note: 2 game hours on the workbench before the bench test.

components_per_part.note: 1: one salvaged part in, one working component out (state.parts, ledger parts_from_salvage). Nothing is made from rock.

samples.json references.note: Provenance only: mission Mars Science Laboratory (Curiosity), instrument CheMin (X-ray diffraction), site Gale crater, data set msl-m-chemin-4-rdr-v1 named on the S06 page. No sample product was opened; the reference mineral shares are illustrative, not from the archive, and are not a measurement of the fictional map.

samples.json readouts.note: Every mineral share of the control, the references and the three sites is illustrative, not from the archive.

samples.json site rock types.note: Which rock lies at which site of the fictional map is made up for the game.

samples.json mineral group words.note: General geology words (volcanic minerals, clay, sulfate salts, glass) used as plain labels; not from the register.

salvage.json parts.note: Which donor part fits, its clue and its bench-test words are made up for the game. The donors are existing damaged objects of the map.
